children: South Plains Financial, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $65.3 million, up 20.5% from a year earlier, while net income rose 27.3% to $20.8 million and diluted EPS increased 10.4% to $1.06. Growth reflected increases in net interest income and noninterest income.
Revenue was $65.3M, compared with $54.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 20.5%.
Net income was $20.8M, compared with $16.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 27.3%.
Diluted EPS was $1.06, compared with $0.96 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 10.4%.
The company completed its all-stock merger with BOH on April 1, 2026, adding approximately $685 million in assets and expanding its Texas banking footprint.

For the first nine months of 2026, net interest income increased 16.6% and noninterest income rose 15.6%, with mortgage banking leading noninterest income growth. Mortgage income advanced 64.5%, partly reflecting improved mortgage servicing rights valuations.
Loans grew 21.8% and deposits increased 20.3% from year-end, reflecting the BOH addition and organic growth.
The company implemented a new loan origination system. Merger integration also added personnel, technology and core operating costs.
